class="primary-container"> <div class="page-width-container" id="page-width-container">    <div class="main-content">                   <article class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Frequently asked questions</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><a class="zippy">Available features for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>
<div>The early version of the app includes many core features of Gemini Notebook and is designed to help you understand anything, anywhere. <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16296687" rel="noopener">Learn more about the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</div>
<a class="zippy">I can't access Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>
  <ul>
    <li>Before you access Gemini Notebook, make sure you verify your age in your Google Account. <a href="/accounts/answer/10071085" rel="noopener">Learn how to access age-restricted content and features</a>.</li>
    <li>Check if your country is supported in the <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13575153" rel="noopener" target="_blank">180+ regions where Gemini app is available</a>.</li>
    <li>If you use a work or school email address and can't access the app, <a href="/a/answer/181865?hl=en#zippy=%2Cturn-services-on-or-off-for-users" rel="noopener">learn how to turn additional Google services on or off</a>. To turn on the Gemini Notebook app, work with your workspace admin.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy">I can't access Gemini Notebook with my work or school email</a>

<div>
  <ul>
    <li>Businesses, schools and universities, organizations, and enterprise users can access higher limits and expanded features with enterprise-grade data protection through:
      <ul>
        <li><a href="https://workspace.google.com/solutions/ai/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Google Workspace</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://edu.google.com/intl/ALL_us/workspace-for-education/editions/compare-editions/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Google Workspace for Education</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/resources/notebooklm-enterprise" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Google Cloud</a></li>
      </ul>
    </li>
    <li>If you use a work or school email address and can't access the app, <a href="/a/answer/181865?hl=en#zippy=%2Cturn-services-on-or-off-for-users">learn how to turn additional Google services on or off</a>. To turn on the Gemini Notebook app, work with your workspace admin.</li>
    <li><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734" rel="noopener">Learn more about using Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account.&nbsp;</a></li>
  </ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy">My question wasn't answered</a>

<div>
  <p>Sometimes Gemini Notebook can’t answer your question because of:</p>

  <ul>
    <li><strong>Safety flags: </strong>The content of your source contains language that triggers a safety flag. This occurs with sensitive topics like violence, sexuality, or obscenity, even in historical contexts.</li>
    <li><strong>Unclear phrases:</strong> When your notebook contains many sources, Gemini Notebook retrieves the most relevant information based on your question, then builds a response from it. A specific question helps Gemini Notebook locate the most relevant pieces of information.
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Tip:</strong> Make your question more precise and understandable.</li>
      </ul>
    </li>
    <li><strong>Information not in sources:</strong> Gemini Notebook answers questions based on the information provided in your uploaded sources. If the answer isn't in the source material, it won't provide a response.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy">How to report offensive responses generated in Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>
  <p>If you think a response generated in Gemini Notebook is offensive or unsafe, let us know.</p>

  <p>To report a response, select thumbs down <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/_DLwtJB8hM9uNlcBMzq6e1L1XGwgOMDR5y333rh9ohBxO-dU6SCgKQl-lvVa8ttlkbU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/_DLwtJB8hM9uNlcBMzq6e1L1XGwgOMDR5y333rh9ohBxO-dU6SCgKQl-lvVa8ttlkbU"><strong> </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong> </strong><strong>Offensive/unsafe </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong> Submit</strong>.</p>

  <p>We’ll review the report and take appropriate actions to improve the safety of our model.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div class="zippy-wrapper">
  <h2 class="zippy">Why does the share menu show a lock icon?</h2>

  <div>
    <div>While a notebook isn't shared with anyone the lock icon will appear indicating the notebook is private. It changes to the shared icon when the notebook is shared individually with users, and a globe icon when the notebook is publicly shared.</div>
  </div>
</div>
<a class="zippy">How to report a privately shared Notebook for my infringed rights</a>

<div>
  <p>If you find content in a privately shared notebook that violates the law, let us know by either opening the settings menu in your notebook and selecting Report Notebook or by visiting this <a href="/legal/troubleshooter/1114905" rel="noopener">direct link</a>.</p>

  <p>We’ll review the material and consider if we’ll block, limit, or remove access to it.</p>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also report through <a href="/legal/troubleshooter/1114905" rel="noopener">report content on Google</a>.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy">My data's privacy in Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>Your data will never be shared by Gemini Notebook. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16179536" rel="noopener">Learn how Gemini Notebook protects your data</a>.</div>
<a class="zippy">Limits for Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>
  <p>With Gemini Notebook, you:</p>

  <ul>
    <li>Get 100 notebooks, with up to 50 sources each and 500,000 words each.</li>
    <li>Have daily limits of 50 chat queries and 3 audio generations.</li>
  </ul>

  <p><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16213268" rel="noopener">Learn more about upgrading Gemini Notebook to increase your limits</a>.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy">File size limit for sources in Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>The current limit is 500,000 words per source or up to 200MB for local uploads. There’s no page limit.</div>
<a class="zippy">My source import failed</a>

<div>
  <p>Sources can’t be imported into Gemini Notebook if:</p>

  <ul>
    <li>It exceeds the allowed 500,000 word limit per source.</li>
    <li>The file size exceeds the allowed 200MB limit.</li>
    <li>Your original PDF file is copy-protected.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy">How sources, chat context, and notes are used in prompts</a>

<div>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Notes:</strong> Only when you specifically select it.</li>
    <li><strong>Sources:</strong> Always used in either the entire set or the subset you select.</li>
    <li><strong>Conversation history:</strong> Used to generate responses.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy">I don't always get citations</a>

<div>If your source content is too short, Gemini Notebook references the entire document without a cited individual text from your source.</div>
<a class="zippy">Recover deleted notes in Gemini Notebook</a>

<div>Unfortunately, there's currently no way to recover deleted notes.</div>
<a class="zippy">Duplicate a notebook</a>

<div>This feature isn’t supported yet.</div>
<a class="zippy">Still have questions</a>

<div>Send your questions and support request to notebooklm-user-support@google.com. If you’re a workspace user, <a href="/a/answer/1047213">contact Google Workspace support</a>.</div>
</div>   </div></section>      </article>       </div>    <div class="side-container"><div id="helpguide"></div> <div data-page-data-key="fixed-sidebar-required" style="display:none">true</div> <div
